_about: The adult side of life (dungeon/world/intimacy.py): only ever for adults, only ever consensual between adults. Tier 1 is mild, 3 is bold. `text` goes in the person's own prompt after 'Into:'.  The 'qualities' group is who someone is drawn to rather than what they do: rolled on its own, never read as an intimate word in a chat. tests/test_intimacy.py checks every entry against a list of banned themes.
